# laravelforge_site_deploy_script (Resource)

Manages the deployment script of a Laravel Forge site. The script is a singleton on the site (no separate ID): it is read via `GET` and replaced via `PUT`, and removing the resource leaves the script in place (Forge has no destroy endpoint for it).



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `content` (String) The content of the deployment script.
- `organization` (String) Organization slug.
- `server_id` (Number) ID of the server the site belongs to.
- `site_id` (Number) ID of the site whose deployment script is managed.

### Optional

- `auto_source` (Boolean) Make `.env` variables available to the deployment script.
